about: Cohan Law Firm is a personal injury firm with offices in Manhattan and Brooklyn.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 2 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

G1.evidence: This firm names no attorney on its public pages, so there is no roster whose licensure can be checked. The register is open and free to search; the names are what is missing.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on its public pages, so there is no roster whose disciplinary history can be checked. The register is open and free to search; the names are what is missing.

G3.evidence: No matching entity found in the active corporations register. New York does not require a general partnership to file with the Department of State, so this is not evidence against the firm, only a check we could not complete from this source
G3.source: Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State, partial

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 614 public client reviews across 2 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2015-03-28, so it has been operating for more than a year
